locations.claim: Hidden state and residual have separate normalization boundaries.
The loop reuses layer modules. This function does not retain an activation history for a codec.

source_ledger.claim: Each rank computes output_parallel and passes it to tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce when reduction is enabled. The result is not a collection of peer-local histories.

The coordinator dispatches an out-of-place All-Reduce operation.

Default reduction is SUM. NCCL receives tensor count, tensor dtype, reduction operation, communicator, and stream. No decoder-base parameter exists.

xor_transport.formula: code = bits16(payload) XOR bits16(base); bits16(payload) = code XOR bits16(base)
xor_transport.lossless_condition: The decoder retains the exact base bits and matching dtype, shape, layout, and packet version.

base_lifetime.receiver_lease_start: Before a dependent packet can arrive.
base_lifetime.release_condition: All dependent encoder and decoder readers finish. Required completion acknowledgments arrive.
base_lifetime.promotion_condition: Both endpoints agree on the next immutable base version and its ordering.
base_lifetime.missing_base_action: Full bootstrap, charged fetch, or valid charged recomputation.
base_lifetime.wrong_version_action: Reject or recover explicitly. Do not silently decode with another version.
base_lifetime.branch_prune_rule: Keep the base lease until pending codec readers finish, even if the branch loses.

ownership_cases.base: previous local partial from sender i
ownership_cases.initial_owner: rank i while its operand buffer remains valid
ownership_cases.required_extra_state: Retained local history plus a mechanism that establishes it at each decoder that requires it.

ownership_cases.initial_owner: all participating ranks receive that output
ownership_cases.receiver_has_base_automatically: Only as a transient operand, not as a guaranteed retained history.
ownership_cases.required_extra_state: A per-operator, per-row immutable retained version.

ownership_cases.base: prior MLP input or prior MLP output at the same tensor boundary
ownership_cases.initial_owner: Both stable endpoints can observe the version after its original transfer.
ownership_cases.required_extra_state: Matching retained versions at both endpoints. Bootstrap after cold placement or migration.

ownership_cases.base: prior hidden activation or projection output
ownership_cases.initial_owner: Its producer and any endpoint that previously received that exact version.
ownership_cases.required_extra_state: Lineage-aware cache and reader leases. A shared KV prefix alone is insufficient.

structural_accounting.evidence_class: analytic capacity, not measured allocation or a universal minimum

structural_accounting.all_sender_histories_at_each_receiver: Can multiply the local-partial family by P. This is an example retention design, not a universal minimum.
